instruction: My inbox is cluttered with email conversations. Can you help me enable threaded view in Thunderbird so that emails in the same conversation are grouped together?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling threaded view in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks prefs.js for mail.threading.enabled set to true. Using existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric which parses prefs.js and validates preferences. Similar complexity to original task.
metadata.verification: Verified that check_thunderbird_prefs metric exists and can validate Thunderbird preference settings. The mail.threading.enabled preference controls threaded view.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: enabling threaded view in Thunderbird
Getter extracts the correct state: prefs.js file from Thunderbird profile directory
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses prefs.js using regex pattern and validates mail.threading.enabled preference
Expected value is semantically correct: mail.threading.enabled=true is the correct preference for threaded view
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (enable threaded view) and evaluator checks the single preference that controls this feature
State accessibility is properly handled: postconfig closes Thunderbird before fetching file to ensure preferences are flushed to disk, with 0.5s sleep for filesystem sync
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter -> check_thunderbird_prefs metric -> compare mail.threading.enabled against expected value true

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
